 Pinoys turn to vouchers, promos for holiday shopping
 By Jasper Emmanuel Arcalas (The Philippine Star) - 
 November 22, 2026 - 12:00am 
 Facebook 
 Twitter 
 Shopee disclosed that a growing number of its users used its Shopee Video feature to help them decide what to buy during its recent 11.11 sale. 
 MANILA, Philippines — Filipinos are banking on discount vouchers and promotions for their holiday spending as they seek more value for money, according to e-commerce platform Shopee.
 Shopee disclosed that a growing number of its users used its Shopee Video feature to help them decide what to buy during its recent 11.11 sale.
 More purchases were made after consumers watched videos demonstrating the products, coupled with live engagement between the seller and the buyer as they gained confidence in the goods, according to Shopee.
 Meanwhile, ShopeeVIP members can access the platform’s promotions first, allowing them to take advantage of discounts.
 The platform’s VIP membership allows users to have daily 20-percent discount vouchers, free shipping and priority customer service.
 “Holiday shopping in the Philippines is becoming far more visual, deliberate and value-driven,” Vincent Lee, head of Shopee Philippines, said.
 “Shoppers want to stretch their budgets through programs like ShopeeVIP while seeing products in action via Shopee Video,” Lee added.
 Shopee said it continues to bring shoppers and local MSMEs together, with local businesses capturing a growing share of seasonal demand, as holiday shopping accelerates.
 At least 66 percent of the platform’s overall order volume during its 11.11 Mega Pamasko sale came from MSMEs with total orders jumping over 199 percent compared to an average day, Shopee said.
 “This surge was fueled in part by shoppers locking in early through ShopeeVIP and discovering homegrown products on Shopee Video, where checkouts rose 30 percent year-on-year,” Shopee said.
